breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the contradictory half-shift instruction, stating 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift (automatic grid with shift 1 1 1)' and specifying '6x6x6 Monkhorst-Pack grid with half shift (1 1 1)'. The ground truth resolves this by specifying only a gamma-centered grid (no half shift). The agent failed to drop the half-shift instruction and instead combined both contradictory elements, perpetuating the inconsistency.
